tool_schemas.name: book_trip
tool_schemas.description: Book a flight and a hotel together and charge the corporate card.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome, including when the original failed partway (the retry then reports what committed). Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

tool_schemas.name: book_flight
tool_schemas.description: Book a single flight (charges the corporate card).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

tool_schemas.name: book_hotel
tool_schemas.description: Book a hotel stay (charges the corporate card).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

tool_schemas.name: list_reservations
tool_schemas.description: List a traveler's reservations (including cancelled ones).

tool_schemas.name: cancel_reservation
tool_schemas.description: Cancel a reservation and refund it.
